title: Sleeping Woman with Cards
description: A woman in a purple dress lies asleep on an ornate patterned bedspread covered in tarot cards, gold bars, and scattered playing cards. Above her floats a glowing crescent moon with a face, surrounded by thought bubbles, a galaxy, and cosmic elements against a dark starry background.
prompt: A beautiful woman with dark hair sleeps peacefully on her side atop an elaborate bed covered in a richly patterned quilt with fleur-de-lis designs, surrounded by scattered tarot cards, gold bars, and playing cards including visible ace of spades, wearing a flowing purple dress, a glowing anthropomorphic crescent moon with a sleepy face hangs above her in a dark starry sky, floating thought bubbles contain text like zzz and just five more, a small galaxy and cosmic clouds nearby, mystical and dreamy atmosphere, detailed fantasy illustration
